language: report in English; raw tables English
mandate: Test whether the short-horizon-response / long-horizon-benefit failure (B0/A0P/A0T-extra) comes from switching local dynamical regimes during training. PRIMARY output is a switching linear response model (local per-regime maps vs a single global map) fitted on the reduced state psi_t. No new model training; native replay from frozen checkpoints only, gated bitwise against frozen B0 diag.
hypothesis: The failure is not response noise: the tangent/linear response model is locally valid within a metastable regime and fails across regime transitions. Operationalized as Q3a (switching one-step linear maps on psi_t) with Q1 (regime structure vs two nulls) and Q2 (chi by regime) as supporting evidence.
primary_question: Q3a: local model psi_{t+1} = A_{z_t} psi_t + b_{z_t} + eps (reduced form of R = C Phi_i B) vs global model psi_{t+1} = A psi_t + b + eps (single Phi). Measured: held-out one-step prediction error, split into within-cluster steps (z_t == z_{t+1}) and across-transition steps (z_t != z_{t+1}); transition points; cluster persistence time. Supporting: Q3b occupancy-mixture vs constant prediction of the frozen response chi_H (leave-one-cell-out CV, frozen a0c _metric).
relation_to_b05: B0.5 (complete) found H1/H2/H3 all NOT_SUPPORTED: retained after-effect is carried by direct theta displacement (not m/v memory; m kernel ~12 steps, v barely diverges), no slow-fast split at the 64-step scale, pure time-reparameterization falsified. Therefore B0.6 tests regime switching at the level of the THETA TRAJECTORY / reduced state dynamics, not optimizer memory; any switching structure found must be consistent with B0.5's fast m-memory and theta-displacement-carried gains.

state_vector.channel_policy: lr_native is a controlled schedule input and train_loss level is cell/step-specific; both are recorded but excluded from clustering channels. g_cos at h=1 is 0 by convention (no previous gradient).
normalizations: pooled_standardized (scaler fit on train windows only)
within_cell_standardized (per-trajectory stats over train window) - reported as robustness variant
state_vector.response_magnitude_channel: per-cell frozen chi from B0 response_curvature.csv; cross-sectional only, never per-step

sample.identity_rule: identical (seed, step, stream) sample as B0 native arms so every replayed trajectory is bitwise-gated against frozen B0 diag rows

replay_stage.semantics: native LR only (multiplier 1.0 at every optimizer step), T=64, NO eval calls (zero RNG perturbation relative to the training sequence), frozen v07 recipe: same bank checkpoints, same make_stream recipe (derive_stream_seed(x,404) + batches_from_train_pool), same pe._baseline_no_step / pe._clip_and_step primitives as b0_run_v01.run_arm
replay_stage.distance_note: B0.5 lesson: the model state_dict contains a 1.64M frozen rotary buffer; all norms/cosines use the named trainable subset (rt['named']), never the raw state_dict
replay_stage.not_new_training: replay of the frozen native recipe from frozen checkpoints; no intervention arms, no new models, no checkpoint/seed/stream/T expansion

smoke: crn_native_repeat (recorder run twice: all recorder fields bitwise equal at every h)
m_v_finite_positive (m_norm, v_norm finite and > 0 at every h)
bitwise_vs_frozen_b0_diag_h1_8 (recorder shared fields == frozen B0 main_diag rows for cell 2030x46 stream 7500, h=1..8)
gates.main_gate: bitwise_vs_frozen_b0_diag_full: grad_norm, update_norm, update_cos_prev, train_loss, preclip_norm, lr_native, lr_applied, multiplier, clip_active equal frozen B0 main_diag/stress_diag native rows for ALL 26 trajectories x 64 steps; fail => stop and fix

analysis.k_selection: best HMM k by held-out test loglik; GMM table reported alongside

nulls.phase_null: multivariate phase-randomized surrogates (n=39, seeded): preserve per-channel spectra and cross-channel linear correlations; stationary linear Gaussian reference
nulls.drift_null: continuous-drift surrogates (n=39, seeded): per-trajectory smooth drift (w=9 moving average) transplanted from a random donor trajectory (possibly time-reversed) + phase-randomized residual; smooth drift + stationary fluctuations without discrete switching. Apparent regimes must beat BOTH nulls.
nulls.requirement_trace: user amendment: continuous drift null added alongside phase null

thresholds_frozen_before_results.q1_verdict_rule: SUPPORTED iff (i) HMM k=2 test_ll > k=1, (ii) best-k HMM test_ll > phase-null p95, (iii) mean run length >= 8 AND switch rate <= phase-null p95, (iv) mean run length > drift-null p95; NOT_SUPPORTED if (i) or (ii) fails; else UNRESOLVED
thresholds_frozen_before_results.q2_verdict_rule: SUPPORTED iff permutation p < alpha AND seed-sign consistency >= 2/3 in at least half of the tested (protocol, H) rows; NOT_SUPPORTED if no row passes; else UNRESOLVED
thresholds_frozen_before_results.q3a_verdict_rule: SUPPORTED iff local map overall held-out error (within + across, across_weight=1) < global AND local across-transition error > local within-cluster error; NOT_SUPPORTED if local not better overall; else UNRESOLVED
thresholds_frozen_before_results.q3b_verdict_rule: SUPPORTED iff local favored in >= 2/3 seed folds; NOT_SUPPORTED if 0 folds; else UNRESOLVED
thresholds_frozen_before_results.headline_rule: Q3a is the headline verdict; Q1/Q2 are supporting. If Q1 is NOT_SUPPORTED, Q3a/Q3b are relabeled NOT_TESTED (no regimes to switch between) and the headline becomes the negative statement.

budget.guard: stop and report if the cap would be exceeded; no silent expansion of cells/arms/streams/T

terminology.rule: no banned term may appear in any conclusion (reporting a banned term only to quote the ban itself is allowed)

statistics.independent_clusters: 3 training seeds (main) + stress seed 2030; streams/timepoints are NOT independent seeds
statistics.scale: pilot (6 cells x 4 streams = 24 trajectories + 2 stress); report per-cell values and ranges; no strong small-p claims; seed-cluster bootstrap if any, flagged exploratory
statistics.hindsight_labels: retained-gain decay analysis and all Viterbi-derived quantities are within-sample/descriptive, not deployable

excluded_without_new_authorization: new training runs or new models
intervention arms beyond frozen B0 artifacts
claims beyond the 64-step recorded horizon (A0P long-memory caveat mandatory)
forbidden: no new optimizer / no optimizer or scheduler modification
no cherry-picking cells by response sign or outcome
no claim of physical phase transition; use metastable regime / switching dynamics / non-stationary reduced model only
